title: Plan a Birthday Party
learning_objectives: Budget for party supplies within a limit
Pick food that includes energy-giving options

events.description: You're planning your birthday party! You have $50 and 6 friends coming. First, let's pick decorations. Balloons are $5, streamers are $3, and a banner is $8.

choices.label: All three! ($16)
choices.effect: The room looks amazing! Balloons, streamers, and a banner! $34 left.

choices.label: Balloons + streamers ($8)
choices.effect: Colorful and festive! $42 left for food and activities!

choices.label: Make your own decorations ($3 for supplies)
choices.effect: Handmade decorations are the coolest! $47 left and so creative!

events.description: Time for food planning! Pizza costs $15, fruit and veggie trays cost $10, and a cake costs $12. What's on the menu?

choices.label: Pizza + cake ($27)
choices.effect: Pizza and cake — party classics! Everyone will be happy!

choices.label: Pizza + fruit tray + cake ($37)
choices.effect: A full spread! Pizza, fresh fruit, and cake! Lots of energy-giving options!

choices.label: Pizza + homemade cupcakes ($18)
choices.effect: Pizza and homemade cupcakes! Personal touch AND budget-friendly!

events.description: Now let's plan the party schedule! The party is 3 hours. You have games, eating, and cake time. Two friends want to play different games. What's the plan?

choices.label: Games (1hr) → Eat (1hr) → Cake + free play (1hr)
choices.effect: A clear plan! Everyone knows what's happening and when!

choices.label: Let everyone vote on what to do next
choices.effect: Democratic party planning! Everyone feels included in the decisions!

choices.label: Play both games, then eat and cake
choices.effect: Both friends' games get played! Great compromise!

events.description: Party is almost over! One friend seems a little left out because they didn't win any games. What do you do?

choices.label: Ask them to help with a special job
choices.effect: You asked them to help serve cake! They feel important and included!

choices.label: Start a team game where everyone wins
choices.effect: A cooperative game means everyone's on the same team! Everyone's laughing!

choices.label: Sit and chat with them
choices.effect: Sometimes a friend just needs someone to talk to. You're a great friend!

recap_template: You planned an amazing birthday party! You budgeted for supplies and food, scheduled activities, picked energy-giving snacks, and made sure all your friends felt included.
positive_framing_rules: Never say the student overspent or the party was lacking
Celebrate both budget-friendly and splurge choices
Frame social awareness as a strength
ai_variation_allowed: Add a surprise moment like a fun delivery
